 Barcelona vs Real Madrid Barcelona Real Madrid LaLiga Vinicius Junior Y. Diomande Spain Brazil Côte d’Ivoire A special event awaits the Ivorian star
 Real Madrid player, the Ivorian Yan Diomande, is set to mark a distinctive individual milestone in his first Clasico against Barcelona. 
 Los Blancos travel to Barcelona tonight in the tenth round of the Spanish league. The Catalans want to break their rivals and stretch the gap between them to nine points. 
 Barcelona sit top of La Liga on 27 points. Atletico Madrid follow on 25 after beating Deportivo La Coruna 1-0 yesterday, with Real Madrid third on 21. 
 According to AS , the Ivorian international stands one step from a record at this tender age, lining up for tonight's Clasico aged 19 years and 346 days.
